cuts.cut: saw motor + ESC: D3536/Skywalker40A -> A2212 1400kV + SkyWalker 30A V2, belt 0.9
cuts.cost_of_cut: energy 70.1 J (was 69.0), spin-up 0.44 s (was 0.33); A2212 is rated ~15-20 A, the 30 A spin-up overloads it briefly

cuts.cut: arm (2.3) + towers/tongue (1.6) + stop posts (3.2 flat): CNC/laser 6061 -> steel, hand-cut + welded; + UHMW nose skid
cuts.cost_of_cut: arm stiffness x2.22 vs 3 mm 6061; under a 69.0 J hit the plates see 169 MPa at the stop (SF 1.45), arm survives ~144.5 J; tongue/posts/skid mass is in the CAD total, not in this row

cuts.cut: forks: laser-cut 65Mn 12x3 -> mild flat bar 12x4 on edge (hinged), one 6 m bar
cuts.cost_of_cut: SF dropped-on-tip 4.09 (65Mn 3 mm flat was 2.17); sideways 30 N push at the tip SF 4.19; straighten between fights

cuts.cut: saw disc: laser-cut -> 3 mm SS400 offcut ground to a 1:1 template (as R4-DIY disc)
cuts.cost_of_cut: same outline = same energy; softer teeth wear, regrind

cuts.cut: UBEC 8 A dropped: the SkyWalker 30A V2 BEC (5 V / 5 A) runs servo + ESP32
cuts.cost_of_cut: servo at 5 V: 1.86 N m and 0.16 s/60 deg instead of 2.1 N m / 0.14 s at 6.8 V; still above the 1.3 N m clutch
